verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MUSANYUKE abalonde
Abeesiga Yesu,
Ettabaaza zammwe zaake,
Obudde buzibye.
Mukama waffe alijja,
Kaakano ali kumpi,
Muyimuke mwekuume
Meleme-okwebaka

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Mukoleeze-ettabaaza
zaake mu nzikiza,
Mulabe-obulokozi
Bwammwe busembedde.
Mukama bamulengera
Kaakano ali kumpi,
Mugende nga muyimba,
Okumusisinkana.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Abawala ab'amagezi
Muyimbe nnyo nnyini
Ennyimba-ez'amatendo
Ez'abamalayika.
Yesu atulindirira
Mulokozi w'abantu:
Balokole ba Yesu,
Musembere mwenna.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Tukkiriza ggwe Yesu
Mulokozi waffe,
Yanguwa-okujja,olye
Obwakabaka bwo.
Katonda atubeerenga
Okubuuliranga wonna,
Balokoke bonna.
